verdicts.opus: C answered the hard part: OpenAI has the most volume, but Anthropic's gap to OpenAI narrowed from about 7.9:1 to 1.9:1. The ratios recompute exactly, the censoring is read correctly, and the anomalies are flagged. A had cleaner full-series exports and exact share arithmetic, but it misread May as censored and framed its decision around volume alone. B and D were honest but unmeasured.
verdicts.gpt: D is the strongest decision aid: it compares all three terms on a shared scale, shows the monthly pattern, and carries the ingest caveat into its reading. A covers more caveats and follow-up questions, but its sampled trend export and unsupported coverage claim weaken trust; D still needs item-level evidence and a clearer reconciliation of May's partial status.
